This small piece of land behind my house is only about seven plots of cassava and some cocoyam — not even a quarter of my farming. I don cut cassava stems from last year harvest, and I go plant the same way my mother teach me. Fertilizer na for the maize people up north; for cassava for this our sandy soil, I just throw small kitchen ash and the goat droppings wey gather for backyard. I no get money to waste on chemical for this small plot, and the rain here plenty enough — no need to fetch water.
